hooks.command: r=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'); f="${r:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/cadence_hooks.sh"; if grep -qsE '^[[:space:]]*\[dev-cadence\][[:space:]]*(#.*)?$' "${r:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/docs/cadence.toml"; then if command -v dev-cadence >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && dev-cadence hook session-start); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -ne 2 ] && exit "$rc"; echo 'dev-cadence: the launcher could not run the pin in docs/cadence.toml (it said why above), so the cadence session-start hooks did not run (TD-129)'; else echo 'dev-cadence: this repo pins dev-cadence in docs/cadence.toml but no dev-cadence launcher is on PATH, so the cadence session-start hooks did not run; install it once per machine: clone dev-cadence at its latest tag, then run: install -m 755 launcher/dev_cadence.py ~/.local/bin/dev-cadence'; fi; elif [ -x "$f" ]; then "$f" --session-start; fi
